items.title: Apple @ Work: Next to a growing token bill, Macs might start looking like a bargain
items.raw_content: Apple @ Work is exclusively brought to you by Mosyle , the only Apple Unified Platform. Mosyle is the only solution that integrates in a single professional grade platform all the solutions necessary to seamlessly and automatically deploy, manage, and protect Apple devices at work. Over 45,000 organizations trust Mosyle to make millions of Apple devices work ready with no effort and at an affordable cost. Request your EXTENDED TRIAL today and understand why Mosyle is everything you need to work with Apple . Apple hardware costs more than it did a year ago, and if you have purchased a fleet recently, you are feeling it. items.title: ACE Robotics and NTU S-Lab Unveil Mundo, a World Model That Builds Robot Training Scenes From Photos
items.raw_content: Mundo turns one to 12 photos of a real place into an editable 3D scene with physics, then renders robot navigation and manipulation in it. Code and weights are due by the end of November.
